articles.headline: No. 17 Minnesota women move to 8-0 with 69-50 win over Cincinnati in the Cancun Challenge
articles.description: — Natalie Kussow scored 22 points and grabbed 11 rebounds for No. 17 Minnesota, and the Golden Gophers pulled away in the third quarter to beat Cincinnati 69-50 on Friday night in the Cancun Challenge.
